FLiT 27b6061b9d2302fa8c3252fe770287bb4d07905b

Covers tests/results/main/ecosystem/raw/{flit-base,flit-openmpi,flit-mpich}/
results.sqlite, flit-config.toml and run.log. The databases include upstream
SQL definitions and comments. Configurations derive from upstream defaults
with local build/compiler settings and serialization changes. Logs include
source excerpts from the litmus tests.
LICENSE preserves the complete LLNL license and disclaimer.
SOURCE-NOTICES.txt preserves the SQL/template/test preambles, including
Paranoia's historical author acknowledgments.
